textAuthority: Only closed structured control fields and stable obligation identifiers are normative. Human-readable explanations and examples are non-normative and cannot change failure, default, warning, verification, cache, secret, retention, phase, authority, identity, input, evidence, unsupported, or admission semantics.
identityExplanation: Transport selection never changes portable semantic identity. A provider object, alias, mutable tag, cache key, source path, or deployment name is not a target-member identity.
unsupportedExplanation: If a provider cannot preserve and verify the selected member and its required runtime profile, the adapter returns an explicit unsupported or admission error. It never rebuilds, substitutes, or weakens the member implicitly.

required.explanation: member bytes or content-addressed fetch descriptors

forbidden.explanation: implicit conversion to another member kind

requirements.explanation: provider explicitly accepts the exact member kind and workload platform
provider reports the runtime profile and required capability versions it can enforce
provider storage and runtime do not rewrite member bytes
provider retention and deletion behavior are explicit operator inputs

identityVerification.explanation: Verify Artifact Set and member manifests before upload.
Verify the provider-accepted byte and content digests after transfer.
Link the provider object reference to the verified member identity as non-semantic runtime metadata.

contracts.cacheExplanation: A cache hit is accepted only after the cached object is re-associated with and verified against the requested member content identity.
contracts.secretExplanation: Provider credentials are Operator Configuration; secret-slot values are bound at Create and never enter the transferred Artifact member.
contracts.retentionExplanation: Provider object retention and deletion are explicit Operator Configuration. The adapter records the effective policy and never imports a provider default into Artifact semantics or identity.

runtimeEvidence.explanation: selected runtime profile and implementation identity
post-start conformance required by the selected profile

unsupportedWhen.explanation: provider cannot accept the member kind
provider transforms member bytes without a verifiable output identity
required runtime capabilities or evidence are unavailable
retention or deletion policy cannot satisfy operator requirements
